data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 夏日祭的射击摊
data.description: 祭典射击摊，她以精密到可怕的枪法横扫奖品，摊主脸色发青；抱着赢来的玩偶转身递出去时依然面无表情：「给你。」
data.action: 祭典射击摊，她以精密到可怕的枪法横扫奖品，摊主脸色发青
data.promptProse: Origami carefully presents the stuffed animal won at the festival shooting game, both hands positioned exactly beneath it. The unused wooden cork rifle lies on the counter beside the prize shelf. Her navy school blazer and short white hair frame pale-blue eyes warmed by the smallest hint of satisfaction. In the medium portrait, lanterns illuminate the toy and collar, while shelf compartments behind her hold soft, contained shadows.
